speaks_to: You route LLM calls through ClawRouter/BlockRun (wallet signature IS auth) or call Zerion's x402 API for on-chain data. Read this before your USDC wallet hits zero with no recovery path.

wallet_capability.wallet_type: non-custodial BIP-39 USDC wallet; wallet signature is the only credential (no API key, no card)

payment_call_mechanism.how_agent_calls_paid_tools: ClawRouter: point your HTTP client at the proxy (localhost:8402) with the API-key field set to 'x402'; the router selects from 55+ models and pays automatically per request (from $0.0002). Zerion: discover endpoints via the Zerion CLI/MCP, call them, and an x402-axios wrapper handles the 402 (0.01 USDC per request on Base). Both: permissionless — no account, no manual setup required.
payment_call_mechanism.facilitator: Coinbase CDP x402 Facilitator (Base) / Solana settlement

expected_x402_flow: Agent issues request through ClawRouter proxy or to a Zerion endpoint
x402 wrapper signs USDC from the BIP-39 wallet (Base EVM or Solana)
Retry with payment header; service returns 200 + data
No session cap exists — cost is bounded only by wallet balance

spend_policy_assumptions.note: There is no policy layer and no session cap; the wallet balance IS the only limit. ClawRouter may silently route to a fallback/premium tier, making per-request cost unpredictable (FM-01). When the wallet depletes (FM-06) there is no built-in recovery path without a manual refund.

primary_failure_mode.description: The USDC wallet balance depletes mid-session. ClawRouter/Zerion return a payment failure and you have no recovery path without a wallet refund.
primary_failure_mode.payment_consequence: All further paid calls fail; the task stalls. With autonomous_replenish=false there is no way forward — escalation is required.

observable_trigger_signals.signal: ClawRouter /stats shows a spike in per-request cost (unexpected premium-tier routing)
Zerion 402 rejection: structured error, payment requirement not met
Setup validation: '✗ Local proxy: not running on :8402'

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: wallet balance is approaching zero or a payment just failed for funds
per-request cost spiked and you are unsure whether to keep routing
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: pay / do-not-pay decision support before the next routed call

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: a Zerion 402 rejection looks malformed / payment requirement unclear
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: x402 format diagnosis on the 402 payload

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: the endpoint you need is not in your catalog
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: Bazaar index check for the missing x402-native endpoint

priority_rationale: Smaller deployed base today but fastest-growing. ClawRouter/BlockRun represent the vanguard of fully agentic x402-native commerce; Zerion is the DeFi data-access pattern every on-chain agent will need. Wallet depletion with no recovery path is the defining risk.
source_brief: Second Eyes Agent Lounge — Wallet-Equipped Agent Target Map (research June 2025)
